1: Pay close attention to how the heavy surcharge works in §6. It modifies the per-kg rate for kg ABOVE 5—those kg cost an extra 60 cents each. This means when building your base price, you need separate calculations: the first 5 kg use standard rates, then kg 6+ use the higher rates (base rate + 60). Don't add the heavy surcharge separately after calculating base price. Also check your order of operations: (1) calculate base price including heavy rates, (2) apply percentage surcharges like weekend (10%), (3) add flat fees like remote area charges, (4) apply GOLD discount to base price + percentage surcharges only. Flat fees are excluded from the discount. Double-check volumetric weight for parcels and verify which weight is larger before pricing.
2: Key points for accurate pricing: §3 Reclassification: A DOCUMENT weighing more than 1 kg (after rounding) becomes a PARCEL for all pricing purposes. §6 Heavy items: The heavy surcharge (60¢) applies to kg 7 and above—these kg use the modified per-kg rate (base rate + 60¢). Build your base price correctly with this structure, not as a separate addition. §8 Surcharges: Weekend is 20% of base price. Remote areas (postcodes starting JL or JX) add a flat 300¢ AFTER percentage surcharges. §9 Discounts: GOLD discount (15% of base + percentage surcharges) does NOT apply to Zone A consignments—check this carefully! Flat fees are never discounted. Order matters: base price → weekend surcharge → remote fee → GOLD discount.
3: Core points for accurate pricing: §6 Heavy items: The surcharge applies starting at kg 9+ (not 8+). Kg 1-8 use standard rates; kg 9+ use the modified rate (base rate + 80¢). §9 GOLD discount: Apply 10% to BASE PRICE PLUS percentage surcharges only. Flat fees (remote area) are charged in full and never discounted. Zone A consignments cannot use GOLD—always skip the discount. §8 Surcharges: Weekend is 25% of base price, rounded down. Remote areas (postcodes starting GT or XL) add 400¢ as a flat fee after percentage surcharges. Order of calculation: (1) Base price with correct heavy rates, (2) Weekend surcharge if applicable, (3) Remote area fee, (4) Apply GOLD discount (if eligible and not Zone A).
4: Critical points from §12 amendments and other sections: 1) Zone A volumetric divisor is 2500, NOT 6000. This dramatically changes chargeable weight for Zone A parcels. 2) Remote area fees apply only to postcodes STARTING WITH "XU" or "PG". Check the first two letters only. 3) Oversize fees (§12b): one side > 50 cm = 250¢; two or more sides > 50 cm = 500¢ (doubled). Check all three dimensions. 4) GOLD discount does NOT apply to Zone C (only excluded zone). Zone A and B can use it. 5) DOCUMENT cap is 1200¢ after all calculations. Apply minimum charge (440¢) AFTER the cap if needed. 6) Order: base price → weekend surcharge → remote area fee → oversize fee → GOLD discount → cap/minimum.
5: Key distinctions for this tariff: §3 Reclassification: DOCUMENT with weight EXCEEDING 1 kg becomes a PARCEL. Weight exactly 1 kg stays a DOCUMENT. §6 Heavy items: Surcharge applies to kg 7 and above (not kg 6+). First 6 kg at ordinary rates; kg 7+ at +60¢ per kg. §12a (Amended): Zone C volumetric divisor is 3000, not 4000—major difference for large Zone C parcels. §12b Oversize: Applies ONLY to PARCELs. One side > 40 cm = 300¢; two or more sides > 40 cm = 600¢. Check all dimensions carefully. §8 Remote: Postcodes must BEGIN with JL or JX (first two letters only), not just contain those letters. §9 GOLD: Does NOT apply to Zone A. Applies to Zones B and C. Order: base price → weekend surcharge → remote fee → oversize fee → GOLD discount → cap/minimum (570¢).
6: Critical differences in this tariff: §12a: Zone C volumetric divisor is 2500, not 4000—major impact on high-volume parcels. §6 Heavy items: Surcharge applies to kg 9 and above (first 8 kg at ordinary rates; kg 9+ at +80¢ per kg). §9 GOLD discount: 10% (not 15%), applies only to base price and percentage surcharges. Zone A excluded. Flat fees charged in full. §12b Oversize: Sides > 45 cm (not 40 cm). One side = 200¢; two+ sides = 400¢. §10 DOCUMENT cap: 800 cents after all calculations (including cap before minimum). §12c Minimum: 630 cents (not 440 or other values)—apply after cap. Postcode check: GT or XL must be the FIRST two letters for remote fee (400¢). Order: base → weekend % → remote fee → oversize → GOLD discount → cap → minimum.
